prompt: Create an ultra-realistic 8K image of a group of 10 people standing proudly around a Mastodon, a massive, woolly, prehistoric elephant-like creature. The setting is a snow-covered plain at sunrise, with the first light of day casting a golden glow on the frozen landscape. The Mastodon lies on its side, its long, shaggy fur matted with snow, and its towering tusks curving outward in dramatic arcs. The enormous creature’s thick, woolly coat is a mix of brown, gray, and hints of orange, with its massive feet resting in the snow, leaving deep imprints. The people are dressed in heavy winter gear, some standing on the creature’s back, others kneeling beside its giant tusks, gazing in awe at the immense size of the beast. Their expressions reflect a mix of pride, exhaustion, and wonder at having captured such a legendary creature. In the background, snow-covered mountains rise, and the pale light of the early morning enhances the scene’s majesty and surreal quality. --ar 9:16 --stylize 750 --v 6.1 作者： johnjackson6175
